basics.name: Anand Bhaskaran
basics.label: Lead AI GTM Engineer | Ships Agents Into Marketing Motions | HubSpot + Salesforce + Meta/Google | MBA
basics.summary: Lead AI engineer who builds agents that ship revenue, not slides. At LumApps I own the AI-native GTM stack: multi-agent workflows over HubSpot, Salesforce and Pendo that 2x outbound conversions and forecast $1M/quarter. I decide build vs buy, wire the integrations, run the evals, and instrument cost per request. Prior 6 years at Beekeeper covered a GenAI demo builder for Sales fed by Salesforce data, an in-house LLM pipeline that killed a $337K/year vendor, and co-owning GTM launches with Sales, PM, and Marketing. MBA-trained, founder mindset, comfortable moving from a marketer's brief to a shipped agent without a heavy process.

work.name: LumApps
highlights: Built and shipped AI-native GTM workflows: multi-agent systems (Python, LangGraph, Google ADK on GCP) that turn a rep's brief into researched, personalized outbound at scale over HubSpot, Salesforce and Pendo. 2x open rates, 2x approved opportunities, 2 to 3 hours saved per rep per day, $1M/quarter forecast revenue.

Own the AI economics: eval pipelines on LangSmith, cost-per-request telemetry, token budgets per agent, and build vs buy calls between LangChain, Google ADK, MCP, and off-the-shelf platforms. Nothing ships without a number attached.

Designed AI Brain, a temporal knowledge graph on Graphiti and Neo4j unifying 5+ silos (Salesforce, HubSpot, Pendo, transcripts, product usage) into one time-aware source every agent reads and writes. Grounds outputs, kills hallucinations.

work.name: Beekeeper AG
highlights: Built GenAI demo system for Sales and Marketing: prompts fed by Salesforce data auto-generate per-customer pitch content and demo streams. Turned a manual per-deal task into a self-serve agent workflow; improved demo speed and close rates on real deals.

Co-owned GTM launches with Sales, PM and Marketing (Seasonal Templates, Re-ignite Revenue, Sentiment Analysis). Every launch shipped with instrumentation so we knew within a week if it moved the needle. Employee Referral System became top revenue channel ($1.5M+ generated, $500K ARR).

Replaced $337K in annual vendor translation costs with an in-house Python + OpenAI pipeline shipped in 6 weeks. Full build-vs-buy call: diagnosed the recurring spend, evaluated vendors, built the fix, killed the contract.
Built AI Onboarding Specialist: prompt-driven guide that turns new-signup context into personalized, high-touch setup. 100% of customers guided through onboarding without added headcount.

work.name: Tenity
highlights: Evaluated 20+ startups on architecture, scalability, and AI readiness for seed-to-VC investment decisions. Consultant-style recommendations to investment committees.
Advised portfolio founders on AI/GTM platform selection, agent design, and building revenue infrastructure that scales.

work.name: Dronistics
highlights: Founding engineer for EPFL spin-off drone delivery. Shipped end-to-end platform (Vue, Java, PostgreSQL, AWS) powering 500+ real-world deliveries. Enterprise integrations enabled Unilever partnership and CES Las Vegas showcase.
Owned the full system as single accountable owner: architecture, integrations, data workflows, on-call, and the customer conversations behind them.
